scope: r30 portable policy validation for pre-OS Win+Alt+B serialization. The physical B event is consumed only while DLSS-G is active; eOff must commit on a real Present before the Windows HDR shortcut is replayed. FG remains gated until the replayed HDR transition is observed by the fresh-output detector or HDR bridge generation, after which the existing two-fresh-frame warmup owns recovery.

tests.policy_normal: PASS r30 HDR hotkey guard policy: FG hold, safe replay timing, and bridge handoff
tests.policy_asan_ubsan: PASS r30 HDR hotkey guard policy: FG hold, safe replay timing, and bridge handoff

limitations: Portable tests validate the state/replay policy but cannot prove WH_KEYBOARD_LL can suppress Win+Alt+B on the target Windows/Game Bar build.
MSVC compilation and live Control/Streamline execution require Windows sign-off.
